newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIAN T-BILL TRADE - 2.83 TRLN RBLS TRANSFERRED.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIAN T-BILL TRADE - 2.83 TRLN RBLS TRANSFERRED.

text.p: Government securities dealers had transferred 2.83 trillion roubles to their government securities trading system accounts before the market opened on Thursday, the central bank's open market operations department said.

Only money transferred to trading accounts before the market opens at 11 a.m. (0700 GMT) is available for investing in paper that day. It indicates potential demand for GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ interest-bearing government bonds.

The total limit for short positions available to dealers licensed to conduct repo operations remains 2.00 trillion roubles. The rate for repos taken out on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday remains 18 percent and that for repos taken out on Thursday and Friday remains 21 percent. Repos taken out today will expire on August 11.
